variants.title: Watching Crates
variants.premise: He's counting wine crates on the dock, checking them off his list.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Any ships sailing out from here?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Ask the crew. I've a list to finish, iknami.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: And not for you either, from what I hear.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: What have you heard?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: No captain takes an unproven stranger. That's all.

options.label: Is that wine in the crates?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Moonrise reds, best batch the foreman's had in years.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Try a cup sometime. You won't regret it.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Bellows like a bull if the grapes bruise.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: The worker checks the list again.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Never. Don't plan to start today.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Boats are for other people.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Timoiva.

variants.title: Grapes and Gulls
variants.premise: He's leaning on a crate, watching gulls squabble over spilled grapes.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Could I get passage on a ship from here?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Not from me. I've never owned a boat.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Grapes don't need boats. Neither do I.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: You've really never sailed?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Once, nearly. Turned green before we left the dock.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Isn't it just. Timoiva.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Good shape this harvest, better than last year's.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Foreman's pleased, for once.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Something about proving yourself first. Don't ask me the details.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I just watch crates, iknami.

options.label: I'll get out of your way.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Mind the gulls on your way out.

variants.title: The Quiver
variants.premise: He's stacking empty crates, whistling an old harvest tune.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Any ships sailing out from here?

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: The worker eyes the quiver slung on your back.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Tetamo, wherever did you get that?

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: I won it. In the Colosseum.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Well then, that changes things, doesn't it.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Someone at the harbour in the capital will sort you out.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: North side of the capital. Ask the crew here.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Ask for whoever keeps the ledger. That's above my head.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Good luck to you, iknami.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Thank me when you're on a ship. Timoiva.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Mind the crates on your way past.
